# HHD Renal Consultant & Services, Inc.

> Clinical staffing, biomedical equipment service, education & training, and compliance consulting for dialysis facilities across New York, Connecticut & New Jersey. BONENT-approved certification exam preparation is available nationwide through an online LMS.

HHD Renal Consultant & Services, Inc. is led by Kazim R. Naqvi, CHT, CHBT, CBNT, MPA (President), who brings 27+ years of hands-on nephrology operations, staffing, and biomedical equipment leadership. The company is based at 14 Belmar Lane, Commack, NY 11725, and serves dialysis programs across the NY/CT/NJ tri-state area.

- Phone (primary): +1 (917) 913-2218
- Phone (secondary): +1 (631) 741-2002
- Email: knaqvi@hhdrenal.com
- Address: 14 Belmar Lane, Commack, NY 11725
- Service area: New York, Connecticut & New Jersey (dialysis facility engagements); certification exam preparation available nationwide online

## Services

- [Clinical Staffing](https://www.hhdrenal.com/clinical-staffing.html): Vetted RNs, LPNs, PCTs, and biomedical technicians for in-center, acute, and home hemodialysis programs.
- [Biomedical Services](https://www.hhdrenal.com/biomedical-services.html): Preventive maintenance, RO water treatment, membrane replacement and disinfection, water quality monitoring, AAMI-aligned documentation, and installation support. Manufacturer coverage includes Fresenius 2008T Series, B. Braun Dialog+, Osmonics 23G RO, CWP Central RO, WRO 300H, and the Fresenius AquA full RO & machine line.
- [Education & Training](https://www.hhdrenal.com/education-training.html): New-hire orientation, clinical in-services, CPR certification, and BONENT-approved national certification exam preparation delivered through an online LMS.
- [Compliance Consulting](https://www.hhdrenal.com/compliance-consulting.html): Survey readiness, policy and procedure development, and quality improvement programs aligned to CMS, The Joint Commission, and state department of health requirements.
